1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2022.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2022

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi satu bilion sembilan puluh dua

juta lapan ratus lapan puluh tiga ribu ringgit (RM1,092,883,000) daripada

Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2022 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi

maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

Maksud Amaun

 (RM)

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

 Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2022

IN excercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the

Employees' Social Security Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2022.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2022

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding one billion ninety-two million eight hundred and

eighty-three thousand ringgit (RM1,092,883,000) from the Social Security Fund for

the expenditure on administration of the Scheme of Social Security for the year 2022

is hereby authorized for the purpose specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

 (RM)

Emoluments 280,402,000

Supplies and services 303,456,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 93,066,000

Other expenditures 132,270,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 283,689,000

_________________

 TOTAL 1,092,883,000

Made 28 October 2022

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5Jld.2(23); PN(PU2)58/XXIII]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

 Minister of Human Resources
